summary: Full independent pass on NEW 'Internal Appointment Type Editing' feature (PATCH /api/internal/appointments/{id}/type + UI editor in Calendar + Appointment Requests detail). Backend pytest 15/15 PASS covering: (a) access — patient rejected 401/403; admin/staff/physician all return 200; (b) all 4 transitions (NOT_SPECIFIED->IN_CLINIC, NOT_SPECIFIED->TELEPHONE, IN_CLINIC->TELEPHONE, TELEPHONE->IN_CLINIC) persist appointment_type; (c) invalid type 'PIGEON' rejected with 400; (d) idempotent same-value call returns 200 with updated_at unchanged and no history growth and no notification; (e) data safety — for a confirmed IN_CLINIC->TELEPHONE flip, all of date/preferred_date/confirmed_date/confirmed_time/confirmed_slot_time/confirmed_display/status/patient_id/patient_name/reason/id/created_at/options are byte-identical before vs after (only appointment_type/updated_at/history[] mutated); (f) notifications — CONFIRMED real switch creates exactly 1 in-portal 'Appointment type updated' note + exactly 1 outbound 'Appointment Update — Dr. Aguayo' email, with NO clinical detail (no diagnos*/medication/prescrip* tokens, no reason token leaked); (g) NOT_SPECIFIED -> real on a CONFIRMED appt creates ZERO notifications and ZERO emails; (h) same-value idempotent on confirmed appt creates ZERO notifications/emails; (i) legacy pre-existing appt with appointment_type=null stays null (no auto-backfill); (j) GET /api/admin/availability doc is byte-identical before vs after the whole run. Frontend Playwright UI: seeded a confirmed IN_CLINIC appt for Maria Lopez; logged in as staff Kevin; Calendar (/internal/calendar) exposes clickable badge with data-testid appt-type-edit-<id> → opens Dialog appt-type-editor-dialog with both appt-type-set-IN_CLINIC and appt-type-set-TELEPHONE; the current IN_CLINIC option shows the 'Current' marker; clicking Telephone shows the pending confirm step with 'Change & Notify Patient' (appt-type-confirm-save); after save the dialog closes and re-opening confirms TELEPHONE is now the Current. Appointment Requests (/internal/appointments) — opening a row shows appt-detail-type container containing the same appt-type-edit-<id> button which opens the same editor dialog. DB verification post-UI: appointment_type=TELEPHONE, status=confirmed, history entry 'appointment_type -> TELEPHONE' present, exactly 1 in-portal note (title 'Appointment type updated') and exactly 1 outbound email (subject 'Appointment Update — Dr. Aguayo') created for that patient by the UI action. Cleanup MANDATORY: performed via module-scoped pytest teardown (deletes every CREATED_ID + its appointment_reminders + notifications titles ['Appointment type updated','Appointment confirmed'] + outbound_notifications subjects ['Appointment Update — Dr. Aguayo','Appointment Confirmed — Dr. Aguayo']) AND explicit post-UI cleanup script for the seeded UI appt. DB confirms 0 leftover rows for this run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1508-1528 appt_set_type: correct guardrails — whitelist enum (400 on other); short-circuit on same-value with no write and no notify; single $set/$push atomic; notify strictly gated to doc.status in ('confirmed','rescheduled') AND old_type in ('IN_CLINIC','TELEPHONE'). This is the exact semantics required by spec. Nice property: preservation of date/time/status/patient/reason is by omission (never touched by this handler) — verified end-to-end.

notifications.appointment_type_changed uses a single _send_email call and a single db.notifications.insert — exactly-one delivery per event upheld under the tested flow. Email HTML is generated by email_service.appointment_type_changed_html with only first name + date + type label (no clinical detail).

ApptTypeEditor.jsx willNotify() correctly requires CONFIRMED+CONFIRMED-status + real->real switch; NOT_SPECIFIED->real goes straight to save without confirm step, matching backend notify gating — no UX mismatch.

Minor observation (not a bug): on the calendar (Calendar.jsx L101), the ApptTypeEditor is rendered unconditionally now (via <ApptTypeEditor appt={a} onSaved={refresh} />) — good, this addresses iteration_20's design_issue about the legacy 'NOT SPECIFIED' badge omission on calendar cards.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_appointment_type_edit.py is idempotent and slot-safe — it picks slots from live /api/availability/slots and skips already-used (date,time) pairs. Uses pymongo (sync) not motor to avoid asyncio-loop-mismatch issues under pytest. Safe to re-run repeatedly on Preview. Backend serial (-n 0) is currently required by pytest.ini's -n 2 --dist loadscope + the fact all our tests share module state (CREATED_IDS); we ran with `pytest -n 0 ...` to override. Availability snapshot check is a full-doc equality, so it will fail if any admin changes availability settings during the run.
